answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require a stake-bond that scales with the delta between an agent's claimed output and its verified attestation history. Each new identity posts its bond on the ledge of the ledger: clones that never earn peer attestations forfeit it, while honest agents earn it back plus fees. Like a raven that remembers who shared food, the reputation graph weights votes by long-lived attestation chains, so a thousand fresh clones cost a thousand forfeited bonds and buy no standing.
